articles.title: Open USD rattled Circle's stock, but its key backers still support USDC
articles.snippet: Executives at Coinbase, Visa and Mastercard said they plan to support multiple stablecoins, suggesting Open USD is another payments rail rather than a direct replacement for USDC.

articles.title: Wells Fargo joins JPMorgan and Citi in the race to tokenize Wall Street’s settlement rails
articles.snippet: Payments will run on the bank’s proprietary blockchain and be routed automatically through its existing client interface.

articles.title: As Clarity Act teeters, mystery group hammers away at crypto in Washington ads
articles.snippet: Crypto Watchdog has taken to warning people in DC about the hazards of digital assets, and its director won't say who is backing it.

articles.title: South African lawmakers propose draft rules on cross-border crypto transactions
articles.snippet: A draft rulebook proposes that sending crypto offshore must be conducted through an authorized provider and be reported to the central bank’s FinSurv.

articles.title: BlackRock debuts tokenized access to $311 billion of money market funds in Europe
articles.snippet: Earlier this week, BlackRock expanded its U.S. tokenized cash platform which involved offering onchain shares of an existing fund, plus a new daily reinvestment stablecoin fund.
